parameters.label: Teleport cooldown (frames)
parameters.help: Frames before teleport can be used again.

parameters.label: Save point A on trigger
parameters.help: Save current position as Point A when pressing the button.

parameters.label: Allow horizontal teleport
parameters.help: If true, can teleport to a point on the same level.

parameters.label: Allow vertical teleport
parameters.help: If true, can teleport to a point on a different vertical level.

parameters.label: Max distance (tiles)
parameters.help: Maximum distance between points A and B in tiles.
